name: smog-companion
description: Live air quality and a clean-air planner for winter smog, with a secure AI proxy.

scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test: node --test tests/core.test.js tests/data.test.js tests/modules.test.js tests/features.test.js tests/lib.test.js tests/air-api.test.js tests/ai.test.js tests/rate-limit.test.js tests/views.test.js tests/css.test.js tests/dom.test.js tests/server.test.js tests/start.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
